meta.title: Use async file system APIs instead of sync APIs in install.ts
meta.body_summary: Replace synchronous file system API calls with async equivalents in VSCode extension install script for better performance and Node.js best practices.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced sync fs calls with async in install.ts; maintainer requested test fix after CI failures; Copilot fixed tests, then merged with 3 approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2733 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, though most churn is in the package-lock.json lockfile (2528 lines). The actual source changes are 205 lines. It fits a small-step performance refactor that merged after one round of test-fix review.

review_details.concern_detail: baywet requested Copilot to fix failing unit tests. Copilot identified issues with integration test setup and incomplete fs mocking, then fixed in follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Replacing sync fs calls with async versions improves performance and follows best practices.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Node.js async fs conversion is a known pattern; Copilot delivered the change but tests needed fix due to mocking complexity in CI environment. Merge required passing unit tests.

detection_detail.ci_auto: CI ran unit tests and reported failures; baywet commented on PR to request fix.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Test failures were reproducible in CI; no performance measurement or profiling evidence provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot corrected test config and mocking in commit b3bf920 after baywet's request, and all tests passed subsequently.

core_change_summary.description: In vscode/npm-package/install.ts, replaced synchronous fs.existsSync and fs.readdirSync calls with new async helper functions checkFileExists and isDirectoryEmpty using fs.promises APIs. Added unit tests in install.spec.ts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfile churn (2528 lines) from dependency install/uninstall cycles; jest config tweak to isolate unit tests.
